answer.verdict: Plan % is not on disk: Claude Code 2.1.307 gets it from /api/oauth/usage and the anthropic-ratelimit-unified-5h/7d headers, then copies it into status-line stdin rate_limits. tools/usage_meter.py estimates the same two windows from deduped transcript tokens, prices them from the 2.1.307 catalog, and scales with one /usage calibration. UserPromptSubmit --hook prints one additionalContext line only when 50/60/70/75/78/85/90/95 is newly crossed.

facts.c: /usage is the plan-usage endpoint, not a local file. The binary requests /api/oauth/usage and reads anthropic-ratelimit-unified-5h-utilization, -5h-reset, -7d-utilization, -7d-reset.

Status-line stdin carries rate_limits.five_hour and seven_day as used_percentage and resets_at (unix seconds) after the first API response. spend_limit is a gateway cap. UserPromptSubmit stdin is the prompt, not rate_limits. This meter does not read stdin.
No local JSON under .claude holds used_percentage. stats-cache.json is activity totals; sessions/72984.json is pid/cwd/status; policy-limits.json is policy flags. .credentials.json was not opened.
